page.overview:
Who is Cage Family?

The Cage family, or Carlton family, is a family related to the Hollywood actor Johnny Cage. The family is from a lineage of an ancient Mediterranean cult who bred warriors for the gods — warriors who possessed power beyond that of mortals.

In the New Era, the Cage family no longer carries that power.
